all_items.title: Relation and table keywords in yacc
all_items.description:
The yacc/ grammar uses `relation` and `table` keywords. It may create the impression that there is a difference between these terms, which can confuse users.

I propose allow both table_or_relation block in yacc (for backward compatibility) but use `table` in responses and documentation.
